# Interview Ace

> Real-time AI interview coach for software engineers, product managers, and data scientists. Live transcription, instant tailored answer suggestions, and post-interview analytics. iOS-first, with a Premium tier for unlimited usage and GPT-4.1 / o4-mini quality.

Interview Ace is a native iOS application that helps candidates pass technical, behavioral, system design, and product interviews. The app captures the interviewer's audio, transcribes it via Deepgram Nova-3, classifies each question, and generates tailored response suggestions using OpenAI's GPT-4.1 family and o4-mini for coding questions.

## Pricing

- **Free**: 3 standard + 1 premium interview per 30 days
- **Pro**: 25 standard + 10 premium interviews per 30 days, $19.99/month or $179.99/year
- **Premium**: Unlimited standard + premium interviews, $49.99/month or $449.99/year
